title: Bingsu
description: Bingsu is a South Korea dish made with whole cow milk, sweetened condensed milk, strawberry, mochi rice cakes. This home-scale recipe assigns measured ingredients to the steps where they are used. Quick bingsu uses ready-made sweet red bean paste and grated ice.

steps.instruction: Cool the prepared ingredients promptly, then refrigerate for about 35 minutes until properly chilled.
Shred or tear the cooked components, then fold together with the listed additions.
Arrange the prepared cooked components and listed toppings in a serving dish, keeping hot foods hot and chilled components cold until serving.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
